phrases.latin: in lectum suum positus est, magnum, in quō domī trēs dormiunt, ipse medius
phrases.english: he was put into his own bed, the big one in which all three sleep at home, with himself in the middle
phrases.source: Libellus VI, Reditus: per Alpēs domum

sources: Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word.
